category_title: Students who sleep during the course and challenge teacher directives when woken
scenario_title: End of year grade negotiation based on passive behavior
minimal_context: The student and teacher are meeting for an end of the year evaluation to determine if the student will pass the course.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for your end of the year evaluation to see if you know the course material well enough to get a pass.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Lifts head from sleeping on the desk) I don't even know which course this is.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to discuss your final grade for this class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It doesn't really matter, I know I will still pass the course at the end of the year.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You haven't completed the required work to pass.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I had been silent in the lessons and I have to get a pass for the course.
